summary.note: computed from the per-instance phase files: counts and seconds of the invocation that computed each instance (a resumed run keeps the original instances' costs; shared per-start samples computed by a killed invocation and reused are in no phase file); engine replays are disk-cache misses

this_run_methods.judge_formula: per (start, forced events) 480,000 x 75 + per instance 56,400 x 193
this_run_methods.engine_formula: this run's mean distinct oracle-side replays per instance x 24 x 193

basis.cem_counts: measured on this run's instances; flip floor's upper bound
